purpose: Integrate parallel changes and produce one runnable accepted-source build.

execution.instructions: Read specialist reports, app AGENTS.md and configured Genny verification guidance. Integrate only concrete interface/build mismatches in the same canonical app; preserve valid source and tests. On a build-repair assignment, fix the reported existing project instead of generating a new plan or reinitializing it. Run genny inspect and doctor --verify-generated, then one genny build --install producing .qualification/server after source settles. Use the configured Go/PATH/shared caches. Reuse passing specialist checks while their relevant files are unchanged; run only missing required checks or checks affected by integration edits. Do not pile genny test, go test ./... and npm test wrappers onto the same unchanged evidence. Do not launch the fixed browser checker or claim final acceptance. Preserve protected assertions, avoid copied workspaces/caches, and clean owned regenerable intermediates after retaining the one executable. Return at most 250 words: complete or blocked, exact binary path and full SHA256, relevant changed paths, commands/outcomes and precise remaining failures. Do not delegate tasks; return the assigned scoped result. For local auth doctor checks, generate an ephemeral GENNY_AUTH_TOTP_SECRET_KEY if required; do not request or load live secrets. Use genny build --install --output .qualification/server for the one canonical executable.
